slides.title:
Tom Monaghan loses his
father on Christmas Eve.
He grows up *in orphanages*.
slides.sub:
Born 1937 in Ann Arbor, Michigan.
Catholic orphanage, then foster homes
(Encyclopedia of World Biography).

slides.title:
1960: Tom and his brother
Jim borrow $900 to buy
a *failing* pizza shop.
slides.sub:
DomiNick's, in Ypsilanti, Michigan.
$500 down, says Jalopnik
(Entrepreneur, Jalopnik).

slides.title:
8 months later, Jim wants
out. His half is paid with
the shop's *VW Beetle*.
slides.sub:
A used 1959 Beetle, the delivery car
(Jalopnik, Mental Floss, Encyclopedia
of World Biography).

slides.title:
Tom builds everything on
one promise: hot pizza
*at your door, fast*.
slides.sub:
Renamed Domino's in 1965, first
franchise in 1967. The 30-minute
guarantee ends in 1993 (Entrepreneur).

slides.title: The idea of stressing 30-minute delivery grew out of my insistence on giving customers *a quality pizza*.

6,000+ stores in 60+ countries

Gone for a used Beetle.

slides.title:
Sell one *promise*.
Then keep it.
slides.sub:
Customers don't remember your menu.
They remember what you promised.

✅ One clear promise people can repeat
✅ Show it on every product page
✅ Check you really deliver it
✅ Don't quit at month 8
